From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-01T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (security milestone)

Hi Alice — great to connect today. Quick recap and proposed next steps based on our discovery: 

1) Goals / timeline
- Target commercial close: 2026-07-15 (customer timeline).
- Near-term milestone: Security review + SOC 2 package delivery — target due date 2026-06-12.

2) Proposed MAP (attached): Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx includes milestone owners and dependencies. Key row below: 
- Milestone: Security review + SOC 2 package delivery
  - Redwood owner: Marissa Cole (me)
  - Customer owner: security contact (you to confirm)
  - Deliverables: SOC2 package (attested report, control matrix, evidence list), completed vendor questionnaire
  - Target due: 2026-06-12
  - Dependencies: your security team review, procurement signature after SOC attestation

3) Asks from you
- Please confirm the security contact (and cc) who will own the review.
- Share any internal vendor questionnaire (if you have one) — I attached our MAP but if you prefer, send yours and we’ll fill accordingly.

I attached the MAP draft for editing (Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx). I can also send our SOC2 package (report + evidence checklist) as a PDF once you confirm the recipient.

Next steps: 
- Alice to confirm security contact and any internal questionnaire by 6/03.
- Redwood (Marissa) to deliver SOC2 package and evidence checklist by 6/04 (so your team can start review).

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the package once you confirm the right person.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — appreciated the summary. Quick responses: 

- Security owner: Rahul Patel (rahul.patel@acmecloud.com), Manager, InfoSec. I’ve CC’d procurement separately but will loop them once we have the SOC materials.
- We do have a vendor security questionnaire — attaching our Acme_Vendor_Questionnaire.docx. Ideally our security team gets the SOC2 package + evidence list by 6/10 to align with our internal review window.

One constraint: procurement needs a signed SOW before final approval; can we start the security review in parallel? Procurement contact is procurement@acmecloud.com.

I’ll let Rahul comment on SSO/entitlements and any additional evidence needs.

Best,

Subject: Re: MAP v1 + SOC2 package (for security review)

Marissa — received the package, thanks. Quick notes from InfoSec after a rapid skim: 

- The SOC2 report and control narratives look fine. We’ll need access to a few evidence artifacts (S3 access logs, config exports for the runtime cluster) — see SOC2_evidence_checklist.csv for the specific IDs I marked.
- Preferred format: evidence zip with manifest (CSV) and a short README describing retention windows. If you can provide exports by 2026-06-10 we can complete the review by 6/12.
- SSO: we’ll need a short runbook for OIDC configuration and a list of supported claims — happy to review a short doc.

I’ll block time for a 30-min sync on Thu 6/04 10:00-10:30 PST (invite sent). Procurement noted they can start SOW review in parallel. 

Thanks — Rahul
Rahul Patel
Manager, Information Security | Acme Cloud
rahul.patel@acmecloud.com
